root_cause.text: `nft_ct_expect_obj_eval()` in the netfilter `nft_ct` expectation-object path allocated an `nf_conntrack_expect` object but failed to release its local reference after calling `nf_ct_expect_related()`, causing a reference leak due to missing `nf_ct_expect_put(exp)`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit message explicitly says “nft_ct_expect_obj_eval() allocates an expectation and may call nf_ct_expect_related(), but never drops its local reference,” and the patch fixes this by adding `nf_ct_expect_put(exp);` before return in `net/netfilter/nft_ct.c`.
